foot_desc: Factory-direct manufacturer of hair dryers, curling irons, straighteners and straightening brushes. OEM and ODM orders from 500 pcs.
hero_title: Salon-Grade Hair Tools, Direct From the Factory
hero_sub: High-speed dryers, curling irons, straighteners and straightening brushes. Built for global voltage standards, shipped worldwide.
feat_sub: Four things that decide whether a hair tool programme succeeds in your market
f1_t: Global voltage, out of the box
f1_d: 110-240V dual voltage with US, EU, UK and AU plug options as standard. No rewiring, no returns, no rewrote manuals.
f2_d: CE, CB, ETL, UKCA, RoHS, PSE and KC documentation prepared per destination before your container ships.
f3_d: Logo, housing colour, cord length, packaging and localised manuals tailored to your brand, with tooling support on larger runs.
f4_d: Every batch inspected against AQL 2.5 with full test reports issued before container loading.
cat_sub: Four core categories, one supply partner
cert_note: Certificate scope varies by model and destination. Final documentation is confirmed against your target market regulations before order confirmation.
faq1_q: What is your minimum order quantity?
faq1_a: 500 pcs per model for OEM orders with your own logo and packaging. Mixed containers across up to four models are accepted.
faq2_q: Can you supply dual-voltage models for our market?
faq2_a: Yes. All four categories are available in 110-240V dual voltage, with US, EU, UK or AU plugs fitted to your order.
faq3_q: How long does sampling and mass production take?
faq3_a: Samples ship within 48 hours for standard models, 15-20 days for custom tooling. Mass production runs 25-30 days after deposit.
home_cta_title: Ready to build your hair tool line?
home_cta_sub: Send us your target models, quantity and market. We reply within 12 working hours with pricing and certification scope.
prod_sub: Four categories covering the core of any salon or retail hair tool range
prod_dryer_desc: 110,000 RPM brushless motor dries hair in half the time. Ionic output reduces frizz, and the 110-240V platform ships with US, EU, UK or AU plugs.
prod_curler_desc: Ceramic-tourmaline barrel reaches working temperature in 30 seconds, with five settings from 80 to 230 degrees for every hair type.
prod_straightener_desc: Floating titanium plates with MCH heating deliver even heat in a single pass, cutting styling time and heat damage on thick or coarse hair.
prod_brush_desc: Heated bristles straighten while detangling. The fastest-growing SKU in salon retail, with anti-scald tips for consumer safety.
oem_sub: What you can change on this model
oem1_d: Logo printing or laser engraving on housing, plus custom colour matching from Pantone or physical sample.
oem2_d: Retail box, gift box or bulk carton, with artwork and manuals localised into your market language.
oem3_d: Cord length, plug type, heat settings and accessory sets adjusted to your channel requirements.
detail_cta_sub: Tell us your quantity and destination market for a detailed quotation.
about_sub: A manufacturer, not a trading company
about_p1: VOSIDO has manufactured electrical hair styling tools since 2008, operating eight production lines dedicated to dryers, curling irons, straighteners and heated brushes. Our engineers work on motor efficiency, heating uniformity and thermal safety - the three things that decide whether a product survives its second year in a salon.
about_p2: We supply distributors, salon chains and private-label brands in markets worldwide. Because we build in-house rather than broker, certification scope, tooling and packaging can all be adjusted before production rather than negotiated after.
cap1_d: Separate assembly lines for dryers and heated tools, with 2.4 million units annual capacity.
cap2_d: Thermal cycling, drop testing and electrical safety checks run on every production batch.
cap3_d: Mould fabrication and modification handled on site, shortening custom-project lead times.
cap4_d: Certificates of origin, test reports and market-specific compliance files prepared per shipment.

privacy_intro: This policy explains how we handle information submitted through the enquiry form on this website.
p_collect: What we collect: the name, business email, company, destination country, product of interest, estimated quantity and message you enter into the enquiry form.
p_use: How we use it: only to prepare a quotation and follow up on your enquiry. We never sell or rent your information.
p_share: Who sees it: our internal sales team only. We do not pass your details to third-party marketers.
p_retention: How long we keep it: enquiries are retained for up to 24 months for follow-up, then deleted.
p_rights: Your rights: you can ask us to access, correct or delete your data at any time. If you are in the EEA or the UK, you may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
p_cookies: Cookies: one cookie stores your language preference. We use no advertising or tracking cookies.
